newsitem.title: USA: Enersis sets $800 mln debt in three parts.
newsitem.headline: Enersis sets $800 mln debt in three parts.

text.p: The following debt issue from Enersis S.A. was priced on Thursday, according to lead manager J.P. Morgan Securities Inc.
The issue was Enersis' first international offering and largest ever for a Chilean company, Enersis said.
